sn56.40:1.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu Idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtam pajānāti || la-pe ||
sn56.40:1.2: Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānati || puratthimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vādatthiko vādagavesī
sn56.40:1.3: Vādam assa āropessāmī ti || tam vata saha dhammena samkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati ||
sn56.40:1.6: dakkhiṇāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vādatthiko vādagavesī
sn56.40:1.7: Vādam assa āropessāmī ti || tam vata saha dhammena samkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 3.
sn56.40:2.2: tassassu aṭṭhakukku heṭṭhā nemaṅgamā aṭṭhakukku upari nemassa ||
sn56.40:2.3: puratthimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva naṃ saṃkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya || pacchimāya ce pi disāya || pe [-pa] || uttarāya ce pi disāya || dakkhiṇāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi neva samkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya || ||
sn56.40:2.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave || yo hi koci bhikkhu Idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti ||
sn56.40:2.7: puratthimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vādatthiko vādagavesī Vādam assa āropessāmīti taṃ vata saha dhammena saṃkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn56.40:2.10: dakkhiṇāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya || samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā vādatthiko vādagavesī Vādam assa āropessāmī ti || taṃ vata saha dhammena samkampessati vā sampakampessati vā sampacālessati vā ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || ||
sn56.40:2.14: Dukkhassa ariyasaccassa || la-pe || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipādāya ariyasaccassa || || 6.
sn56.40:3.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
